title: TraceSettings
description: The technical run trace (A1719, B2767/B2768, Marcel W2145/W2146): one JSON-lines file per game day next to the save - every core event, every decider and job log entry with its request_id, and an hourly snapshot of the inhabitants and the movable things - for the TL and the agents to follow a game afterwards (tools/trace/query.py). Reads along only: no world state, no hash, not saved.

enabled.description: Whether the game writes the trace (on in test packages and night runs, B2767). The headless runner writes it with --run-trace whatever this says.

folder.description: Folder next to the save (inside the world's folder) that takes the day files.

snapshot_every_hours.description: Game hours between two snapshots of all inhabitants and movable things.

pack_old_days.description: Pack the files of days before yesterday to .jsonl.gz (B2767: old days packed).
